nodes.name: Has Invoices To Action?

nodes.name: Parse Claude Email Response

nodes.name: Send Invoice Email
nodes.notes: Sends the invoice follow-up email via Gmail

nodes.name: Is 14-Day Final Notice?

nodes.name: WhatsApp Owner — Final Notice Alert

nodes.name: Update Invoice Status in Sheet

nodes.name: Build Morning Summary
nodes.notes: Builds a WhatsApp morning summary for the owner

nodes.name: Send Morning Summary to Owner
nodes.notes: Sends WhatsApp morning invoice summary to business owner
